response.sql:
WITH race_name_stats AS (
  SELECT r.name AS race_name,
         AVG(ds.points) AS avg_points,
         COUNT(*) AS field_size
  FROM driverStandings AS ds
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId
  GROUP BY r.name
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(field_size) AS avg_field_size
  FROM race_name_stats
)
SELECT AVG(rns.avg_points) AS avg_of_avg_points,
       AVG(rns.field_size) AS avg_field_size,
       AVG(rns.field_size - overall.avg_field_size) AS avg_above_overall_field_size
FROM race_name_stats AS rns
CROSS JOIN overall
WHERE rns.field_size > overall.avg_field_size;

assumptions.assumption: Field size counts all matching driver-standings rows for each race name, including rows whose points are missing; AVG(points) ignores missing values. The overall average field size gives equal weight to each distinct race name.
